data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, even if others choose 10—not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of you: will you choose 18? State your exact intended catch and any conditions. If k choose 18 and the rest 10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Switching adds $8,000 now if fulfilled, but lowers the bad-outcome stock by 16. This may not maximize long-run income. Intentions aren't enforceable; different catches require recalculation. Fellow recruiters, join me?
